name: Asahina Ukyou
source:
Birth Date: December 3rd, 1981.

Ukyou is the 2nd son of the Asahina family. He is a successful lawyer and acts as the "mother figure" to the household. He cooks, cleans and helps the others study for school. He has a calm and reliable personality but can also be very talkative.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_Conflict#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
